title: 《代数几何学原理 II》简体中文版 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique II — Unofficial Simplified-Chinese Edition
description:
This is the first release in the single cumulative mainland Simplified-Chinese (zh-Hans-CN) EGA language lineage. It contains the complete EGA II fascicle: front matter, §§1–8 through §8.14.14, bibliography, indexes, contents, and Errata et Addenda, Liste 1, through printed page 222. EGA I is absent and may be added later as a successor in this same concept lineage.

The reader and editable-source archive passed deterministic source/formula/reference replay, serial LuaLaTeX builds, font and glyph checks, extraction, internal-link validation, archive replay, privacy review, and all-page visual inspection. The release is producer-complete and mechanically/visually verified; it does not claim independent Chinese-language certification.

This is an independent, unofficial translation and typesetting project. It does not imply endorsement by the historical authors, IHÉS, NUMDAM, a publisher, or any institution. The NUMDAM scan and French/English witnesses are excluded. No new blanket public-domain or open-license claim is made over the underlying EGA text. The public repository is KokunoYumeto/ega-zh-hans-cn.
